name: Diana Vinchester
source:
Diana is [url=https://vndb.org/c144573]Samantha[/url]’s older sister. They used to be inseparable, but they drifted apart because of their differing views: Sammy did not want to become a hunter, unlike Diana. [url=https://vndb.org/c144566]I[/url] managed to give Sammy a semblance of an ordinary life. [spoiler]When Diana learned that I was married to her sister, she was surprised[/spoiler]. She harbors a deep hatred of demons, but it is clear to me that she is attracted to me.

[In game description]
